units.zh: 方丘儀
units.en: Ceremonial Protocol for the Square Mound
units.literal: Rites of the Square Mound

units.zh: 齋戒：祭前三日質明，有司設三獻以下行事官位於尚書省。
units.en: Purification: Three days before the rite, at dawn the responsible offices assigned stations at the Secretariat for the three offerers and all attending ritual officers.
units.literal: Purification and abstinence: On the third day before the sacrifice, at full dawn, the responsible offices set the stations of the three offering officials and all ritual officers below them at the Secretariat.

units.zh: 初獻南面，監祭禦史位於西，東向，監禮博士位於東，西向，俱北上。
units.en: The initial offerer faced south; the supervising censor stood west, facing east; the supervising ritual academician stood east, facing west—all ranked from the north.
units.literal: The initial offerer faced south; the supervising censor was in the west, east-facing; the supervising ritual academician was in the east, west-facing—all ranked from the north upward.

units.zh: 司徒亞、終獻位於南，北向。
units.en: The Minister of Education as secondary offerer and the final offerer stood in the south, facing north.
units.literal: The Minister of Education as secondary offerer and the final offerer were in the south, north-facing.

units.zh: 次光祿卿、太常卿，次第一等分獻官、司天監，次第二等分獻官、光祿丞、郊社令、大樂令、良醖令、廩犧令、司尊彝，次內濆內外分獻官、太祝官、奉禮郎、協律郎、諸執事官，就位，立定。
units.en: Then came the Directors of Imperial Victuals and Grand Harmony; first-grade distributed offerers and the Directorate of Astronomy; second-grade distributed offerers, victual aide, suburban altar director, Grand Music director, brewer, granary officer, and vessel keeper; inner and outer embankment distributed offerers, grand invoker, ritual attendants, pitch officers, and all executives—they took station and stood fast.
units.literal: Next the Director of Imperial Victuals and the Director of Grand Harmony; next first-grade distributed offering officials and the Directorate of Astronomy; next second-grade distributed offering officials, Imperial Victuals aide, suburban altar director, Grand Music director, Chief Brewer, Granary and Victuals director, and Keeper of Ritual Vessels; next inner and outer embankment distributed offering officials, grand invoker, ritual attendant, pitch officer, and all executive officials—they took station and stood in place.

units.zh: 次禮直官引初獻就位，初獻讀誓曰：「今年五月幾日夏至，祭皇地祇于方丘，所有攝官，各揚其職。
units.en: The ritual attendant then led the initial offerer to his place; he read the oath: "On such-and-such day in the fifth month, at the summer solstice, we sacrifice to Imperial Earth at the square mound—every acting official, perform your charge.
units.literal: Next the ritual attendant led the initial offerer to his station; the initial offerer read the oath: "On such-and-such day of the fifth month, the summer solstice, we sacrifice to August Earth Spirit at the square mound—all acting officials, each perform your charge.

units.zh: 其或不敬，國有常刑。」
units.en: Whoever is not reverent—the state has fixed penalties."
units.literal: Whoever is not reverent—the state has fixed punishment."

units.zh: 讀畢，禮直官贊：「七品以下官先退。」
units.en: When he had finished reading, the attendant called: "Officials of seventh rank and below withdraw first."
units.literal: When the reading was finished, the ritual attendant announced: "Officials of seventh grade and below withdraw first."

units.zh: 餘官對拜，訖，退。
units.en: The rest bowed to one another, then withdrew.
units.literal: The remaining officials bowed facing one another; when done, they withdrew.

units.zh: 散齋二日，宿於正寢，治理如故。
units.en: For two days of dispersed abstinence they lodged in the main quarters and governed as usual.
units.literal: For two days of dispersed abstinence they lodged in the main quarters and conducted governance as usual.

units.zh: 齋禁並如郊祀。
units.en: Abstinence rules matched those for suburban sacrifice.
units.literal: Abstinence restrictions were the same as for suburban sacrifice.

units.zh: 守濆門兵衛與大樂工人，俱清齋一宿。
units.en: Gate guards and Grand Music craftsmen all kept pure abstinence overnight.
units.literal: The guards at the embankment gates and the Grand Music craftsmen all kept pure abstinence for one night.

units.zh: 行禮官前期習儀於祠所。
units.en: Ritual officers rehearsed the ceremony at the shrine beforehand.
units.literal: Ritual officers beforehand practiced the ceremony at the shrine site.

units.zh: 陳設：祭前三日，所司設三獻官以下行事執事官次於外壝東門之外，道南，北向，西上，隨地之宜。
units.en: Arrangements: Three days before the rite, the responsible offices placed the three offerers and all executive officers outside the outer embankment's east gate, south of the path, facing north and ranked from the west, as terrain permitted.
units.literal: Arrangement of offerings: On the third day before the sacrifice, the responsible offices set the stations of the three offering officials and all executive ritual officers outside the outer embankment's east gate, south of the path, north-facing, ranked from the west upward, as the ground allowed.

units.zh: 又設饌幕於內濆東門之外，道北南向。
units.en: They also erected a food canopy outside the inner embankment's east gate, north of the path, facing south.
units.literal: They also set a food canopy outside the inner embankment's east gate, south of the path on the north side, facing south.

units.zh: 祭前二日，所司設兵衛，各服其服，守衛濆門，每門二人。
units.en: Two days before the rite, the responsible offices posted guards in full dress at the embankment gates—two per gate.
units.literal: On the second day before the sacrifice, the responsible offices posted armed guards, each in proper dress, to guard the embankment gates—two men per gate.

units.zh: 大樂令帥其屬，設登歌之樂於壇上，如郊祀。
units.en: The Grand Music director and his staff set the ascent hymn on the altar, as at suburban sacrifice.
units.literal: The Grand Music director led his subordinates to set the ascent hymn music on the altar, as at suburban sacrifice.

units.zh: 郊社令帥其屬，掃除壇之上下，為瘞坎在內濆外之壬地。
units.en: The suburban altar director and his staff swept the altar clean and dug a burial pit at the ren position outside the inner embankment.
units.literal: The suburban altar director led his subordinates to sweep above and below the altar and prepare a burial pit at the ren position outside the inner embankment.

units.zh: 祭前一日，司天監、郊社令各服其服，帥其屬，升設皇地祇神座於壇上北方，南向，席以槁秸。
units.en: On the eve of the rite, the Directorate of Astronomy and the suburban altar director, properly attired, led their staffs up to set Imperial Earth's seat on the north of the altar, facing south, on straw matting.
units.literal: On the day before the sacrifice, the Directorate of Astronomy and the suburban altar director, each in proper dress, led their subordinates up to set August Earth Spirit's spirit seat on the north of the altar, south-facing, with straw matting.

units.zh: 又設配位神座於東方，西向，席以蒲越。
units.en: They also placed the consort's seat in the east, facing west, on rush matting.
units.literal: They also set the consort spirit seat in the east, west-facing, with rush matting.

units.zh: 又設神州地祇神座於壇之第一等東南方，席以槁秸。
units.en: They also placed the Spirit State Earth seat in the southeast of the altar's first tier, on straw matting.
units.literal: They also set the Spirit State Earth Spirit seat in the southeast of the altar's first tier, with straw matting.

units.zh: 又設五神、五官、嶽鎮海瀆二十九座於第二等階之間，各依方位。
units.en: They also set twenty-nine seats for the Five Spirits, Five Officials, marchmounts, garrisons, seas, and streams on the second tier, each in its proper direction.
units.literal: They also set twenty-nine seats for the Five Spirits, Five Officials, marchmounts, garrisons, seas, and streams between the second-tier steps, each according to its direction.

units.zh: 又設昆侖、山大川澤二十一座於內濆之內，又設丘陵墳衍原隰三十座於內濆外，席皆以莞。
units.en: Inside the inner embankment they set twenty-one seats for Kunlun, great mountains, rivers, and marshes; outside it, thirty seats for hills, mounds, dykes, plains, and lowlands—all on cattail mats.
units.literal: They also set twenty-one seats for Kunlun, great mountains, rivers, and marshes inside the inner embankment, and thirty seats for hills, mounds, embankments, plains, and lowlands outside the inner embankment—all with cattail matting.

units.zh: 又設神位版，各於座首。
units.en: They also placed spirit tablets at the head of each seat.
units.literal: They also set spirit tablets, each at the head of its seat.

units.zh: 子陛之西，水神玄冥、北嶽、北鎮、北海、北瀆於壇之第二等，北山、北林、北川、北澤、於內濆內，北丘、北陵、北墳、北衍、北原、北隰於內濆外，皆各為一列，以東為上。
units.en: West of the zi ascent: Water Spirit Xuanming, the Northern Marchmount, garrison, sea, and stream on the second tier; northern mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes within the inner embankment; northern mounds, hills, tombs, dykes, plains, and lowlands outside it—each in one row, ranked from the east.
units.literal: West of the zi ascent: Water Spirit Xuanming, Northern Marchmount, Northern Garrison, Northern Sea, and Northern Stream on the altar's second tier; Northern Mountain, Forest, River, and Marsh inside the inner embankment; Northern Mound, Hill, Tomb, Embankment, Plain, and Lowland outside the inner embankment—each in a single row, ranked from the east upward.

units.zh: 卯陛之北，木神勾芒，東嶽、長白山、東鎮、東海、東瀆於壇之第二等，東山、東林、東川、東澤於內濆內，東丘、東陵、東墳、東衍、東原、東隰於內濆外，皆各為一列，以南為上。
units.en: North of the mao ascent: Wood Spirit Goumang, the Eastern Marchmount, Changbai Mountain, garrison, sea, and stream on the second tier; eastern mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes within the inner embankment; eastern mounds, hills, tombs, dykes, plains, and lowlands outside it—each in one row, ranked from the south.
units.literal: North of the mao ascent: Wood Spirit Goumang, Eastern Marchmount, Changbai Mountain, Eastern Garrison, Eastern Sea, and Eastern Stream on the altar's second tier; Eastern Mountain, Forest, River, and Marsh inside the inner embankment; Eastern Mound, Hill, Tomb, Embankment, Plain, and Lowland outside the inner embankment—each in a single row, ranked from the south upward.

units.zh: 午陛之東，神州地祇於壇之第一等，火神祝融，南嶽、南鎮、南海、南瀆於壇之第二等，南山、南林、南川、南澤於內濆內，南丘、南陵、南墳、南衍、南原、南隰於內濆外，皆各為一列，以西為上。
units.en: East of the wu ascent: Spirit State Earth on the first tier; Fire Spirit Zhurong, the Southern Marchmount, garrison, sea, and stream on the second; southern mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes within the inner embankment; southern mounds, hills, tombs, dykes, plains, and lowlands outside it—each in one row, ranked from the west.
units.literal: East of the wu ascent: Spirit State Earth Spirit on the altar's first tier; Fire Spirit Zhurong, Southern Marchmount, Southern Garrison, Southern Sea, and Southern Stream on the second tier; Southern Mountain, Forest, River, and Marsh inside the inner embankment; Southern Mound, Hill, Tomb, Embankment, Plain, and Lowland outside the inner embankment—each in a single row, ranked from the west upward.

units.zh: 午陛之西，土神後土、中嶽、中鎮於壇之第二等，中山、中林、中川、中澤於內濆內，中丘、中陵、中墳、中衍、中原、中隰於內濆外，皆各為一列，以南為上。
units.en: West of the wu ascent: Earth Spirit Houtu, the Central Marchmount, and central garrison on the second tier; central mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes within the inner embankment; central mounds, hills, tombs, dykes, plains, and lowlands outside it—each in one row, ranked from the south.
units.literal: West of the wu ascent: Earth Spirit Houtu, Central Marchmount, and Central Garrison on the altar's second tier; Central Mountain, Forest, River, and Marsh inside the inner embankment; Central Mound, Hill, Tomb, Embankment, Plain, and Lowland outside the inner embankment—each in a single row, ranked from the south upward.

units.zh: 酉陛之南，金神蓐收、西嶽、西鎮、西海、西瀆於壇之第二等，昆侖、西山、西林、西川、西澤於內濆內，西丘、西陵、西墳、西衍、西原、西隰於內壝外，皆各為一列，以北為上。
units.en: South of the you ascent: Metal Spirit Roushou, the Western Marchmount, garrison, sea, and stream on the second tier; Kunlun, western mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes within the inner embankment; western mounds, hills, tombs, dykes, plains, and lowlands outside the outer embankment—each in one row, ranked from the north.
units.literal: South of the you ascent: Metal Spirit Roushou, Western Marchmount, Western Garrison, Western Sea, and Western Stream on the altar's second tier; Kunlun, Western Mountain, Forest, River, and Western Marsh inside the inner embankment; Western Mound, Hill, Tomb, Embankment, Plain, and Lowland outside the outer embankment—each in a single row, ranked from the north upward.

units.zh: 其皇地祇、及配位、神州地祇之座，並禮神之玉，設訖，俟告潔畢權徹，祭日早重設。
units.en: Once the seats of Imperial Earth, the consort, and Spirit State Earth, with the jade for honoring the spirits, were in place, they awaited the purity announcement; afterward they were temporarily removed and set again early on the day of sacrifice.
units.literal: When the seats of August Earth Spirit, the consort, and Spirit State Earth Spirit, together with the jade for honoring the spirits, had been set, they awaited announcement of purity; when finished they were provisionally removed and reset early on the sacrifice day.

units.zh: 其第二等下神座，設定不收。
units.en: Spirit seats below the second tier, once set, were left in place.
units.literal: The spirit seats below the second tier, once set, were not removed.

units.zh: 奉禮郎、禮直官又設三獻官位於卯陛之東稍北，西向。
units.en: Ritual attendants also placed the three offerers slightly north of the mao ascent's east side, facing west.
units.literal: The ritual attendant and ritual officer also set the stations of the three offering officials slightly north of the east of the mao ascent, west-facing.

units.zh: 司徒位於卯陛之東，道南，西向。
units.en: The Minister of Education stood east of the mao ascent, south of the path, facing west.
units.literal: The Minister of Education's station was east of the mao ascent, south of the path, west-facing.

units.zh: 太常卿、光祿卿位次之。
units.en: The Directors of Grand Harmony and Imperial Victuals stood next in rank.
units.literal: The Directors of Grand Harmony and Imperial Victuals were next in station.

units.zh: 第一等分獻官、司天監位於其東，光祿丞、郊社令、太官令、廩犧令位又在其東，每等異位重行，俱西向北上。
units.en: First-grade distributed offerers and the Directorate of Astronomy stood to their east; the victual aide, suburban altar director, kitchen director, and granary officer still farther east—each grade in its own row, all facing west and ranked from the north.
units.literal: First-grade distributed offering officials and the Directorate of Astronomy were east of them; Imperial Victuals aide, suburban altar director, Imperial Kitchen director, and Granary and Victuals director were again east of those—each grade in separate stations, double-ranked, all west-facing, ranked from the north upward.

units.zh: 又設太祝、奉禮郎及諸執事位於內壝東門外道南，每等異位重行，俱西向北上。
units.en: They also placed the grand invoker, ritual attendants, and all executives south of the path outside the inner embankment's east gate—each grade in its own row, facing west and ranked from the north.
units.literal: They also set stations for the grand invoker, ritual attendant, and all executive officials south of the path outside the inner embankment's east gate—each grade in separate stations, double-ranked, all west-facing, ranked from the north upward.

units.zh: 設監祭禦史二位，一於壇下午陛之西南，一於子陛之西北，俱東向。
units.en: Two supervising censors were posted—one southwest of the wu ascent on the altar, one northwest of the zi ascent—both facing east.
units.literal: Two supervising censors were set—one southwest of the wu ascent on the altar, one northwest of the zi ascent—all east-facing.

units.zh: 設監禮博士二位，一於壇下午陛之東南，一於子陛之東北，俱西向。
units.en: Two supervising ritual academicians were posted—one southeast of the wu ascent on the altar, one northeast of the zi ascent—both facing west.
units.literal: Two supervising ritual academicians were set—one southeast of the wu ascent on the altar, one northeast of the zi ascent—all west-facing.

units.zh: 奉禮郎位於壇之東南，西向。
units.en: The ritual attendant stood in the altar's southeast, facing west.
units.literal: The ritual attendant's station was in the southeast of the altar, west-facing.

units.zh: 協律郎位於樂虡西北，東向。
units.en: The pitch officer stood northwest of the music terrace, facing east.
units.literal: The pitch officer's station was northwest of the music terrace, east-facing.

units.zh: 大樂令位於樂虡之間，西向。
units.en: The Grand Music director stood between the music terraces, facing west.
units.literal: The Grand Music director's station was between the music terraces, west-facing.

units.zh: 司尊彝位於酌尊所，俱北向。
units.en: The vessel keeper stood at the libation station, all facing north.
units.literal: The Keeper of Ritual Vessels was at the libation-vessel station, all north-facing.

units.zh: 設望瘞位坎之南，北向。
units.en: The station for gazing at the burial offering was placed south of the pit, facing north.
units.literal: The station for gazing at the burial offering was set south of the pit, north-facing.

units.zh: 又設牲榜位於內濆東門之外，西向。
units.en: They also set the victim display outside the inner embankment's east gate, facing west.
units.literal: They also set the victim display station outside the inner embankment's east gate, west-facing.

units.zh: 太祝、祝史各位於牲後，俱西向。
units.en: The grand invoker and invoker scribes stood behind the victims, all facing west.
units.literal: The grand invoker and invoker scribes each had a station behind the victims, all west-facing.

units.zh: 設省饌位於牲西，太常卿、光祿卿、太官令位於牲北，南向，西上。
units.en: The inspection station lay west of the victims; the Directors of Grand Harmony and Imperial Victuals and the kitchen director stood north of them, facing south and ranked from the west.
units.literal: The station for inspecting offerings was set west of the victims; the Directors of Grand Harmony and Imperial Victuals and the Imperial Kitchen director were north of the victims, south-facing, ranked from the west upward.

units.zh: 監祭、監禮位在太常卿之西稍卻，西上。
units.en: The supervising censor and ritual academician stood slightly behind and west of the Director of Grand Harmony, ranked from the west.
units.literal: The supervising censor and supervising ritual academician were slightly behind and west of the Director of Grand Harmony, ranked from the west upward.

units.zh: 廩犧令位於牲西南，北向。
units.en: The granary officer stood southwest of the victims, facing north.
units.literal: The Granary and Victuals director's station was southwest of the victims, north-facing.

units.zh: 又陳禮饌於內壝東門之外，道北，南向。
units.en: They also laid out ritual food outside the inner embankment's east gate, north of the path, facing south.
units.literal: They also displayed ritual food outside the inner embankment's east gate, north of the path, south-facing.

units.zh: 設省饌位於禮饌之南。
units.en: The inspection station was placed south of the ritual food.
units.literal: The station for inspecting offerings was set south of the ritual food.

units.zh: 太常卿、光祿卿、太官令位在東，西向，監祭、監禮位在西，東向，俱北上。
units.en: The Directors of Grand Harmony and Imperial Victuals and the kitchen director stood east, facing west; the supervising censor and ritual academician stood west, facing east—all ranked from the north.
units.literal: The Directors of Grand Harmony and Imperial Victuals and the Imperial Kitchen director were in the east, west-facing; the supervising censor and supervising ritual academician were in the west, east-facing—all ranked from the north upward.

units.zh: 設祝版於神位之右。
units.en: Invocation tablets were placed to the right of each spirit seat.
units.literal: Invocation tablets were set to the right of each spirit seat.

units.zh: 司尊及奉禮郎帥其屬，設玉幣篚於酌尊所，次及籩豆之位。
units.en: The vessel keeper and ritual attendants led their staffs to set baskets for jade and silks at the libation station, then the bian and dou placements.
units.literal: The Keeper of Ritual Vessels and the ritual attendant led their subordinates to set baskets for jade and silks at the libation-vessel station, then the stations for bian and dou vessels.

units.zh: 正、配位各左有十一籩、右有十一豆，俱為三行。
units.en: At the principal and consort seats, eleven bian on the left and eleven dou on the right, each in three rows.
units.literal: For the principal and consort seats, eleven bian on the left and eleven dou on the right, all in three rows.

units.zh: 登三，在籩豆間。
units.en: Three deng vessels stood between the bian and dou.
units.literal: Three deng vessels between the bian and dou.

units.zh: 鉶三，在登前。
units.en: Three xing vessels before the deng.
units.literal: Three xing vessels before the deng.

units.zh: 簠一、簋一，各在鉶前。
units.en: One fu and one gui, each before the xing.
units.literal: One fu and one gui, each before the xing.

units.zh: 又設尊罍之位，皇地祇太尊二、著尊二、犧尊二、山罍二，在壇上東南隅。
units.en: They also placed wine vessels for Imperial Earth—two Grand Vessels, two Display Vessels, two Sacrificial Vessels, and two Mountain Jars—in the altar's southeast corner.
units.literal: They also set stations for wine vessels: for August Earth Spirit, two Grand Vessels, two Display Vessels, two Sacrificial Vessels, and two Mountain Jars, in the southeast corner of the altar.

units.zh: 配位著尊二，犧尊二、象尊二、山罍二，在正位酒尊之東，俱北向西上，皆有坫，加勺、冪，為酌尊所。
units.en: For the consort, two Display Vessels, two Sacrificial Vessels, two Elephant Vessels, and two Mountain Jars stood east of the principal wine vessels—all facing north and ranked from the west, each on a stand with ladles and covers, as the libation station.
units.literal: For the consort seat, two Display Vessels, two Sacrificial Vessels, two Elephant Vessels, and two Mountain Jars, east of the principal seat's wine vessels—all north-facing, ranked from the west upward, each with a stand, ladles, and covers, serving as the libation station.

units.zh: 又設皇地祇位象尊二、壺尊二、山罍四，在壇下午陛之西，北向西上。
units.en: For Imperial Earth's seat they also set two Elephant Vessels, two Pot Vessels, and four Mountain Jars west of the wu ascent on the altar, facing north and ranked from the west.
units.literal: They also set for August Earth Spirit's seat two Elephant Vessels, two Pot Vessels, and four Mountain Jars, west of the wu ascent on the altar, north-facing, ranked from the west upward.

units.zh: 配位犧尊二、壺尊二、山罍四，在酉陛之北，東向北上，皆有坫，加冪，設而不酌。
units.en: For the consort, two Sacrificial Vessels, two Pot Vessels, and four Mountain Jars stood north of the you ascent, facing east and ranked from the north—all on stands with covers, set but not for libation.
units.literal: For the consort seat, two Sacrificial Vessels, two Pot Vessels, and four Mountain Jars, north of the you ascent, east-facing, ranked from the north upward—all with stands and covers, set but not for libation.

units.zh: 神州地祇位左八籩、右八豆，登一在籩豆間，簠一、簋一在登前，爵坫一，在神座前。
units.en: At Spirit State Earth's seat, eight bian left and eight dou right; one deng between them; one fu and one gui before the deng; one libation stand before the seat.
units.literal: At Spirit State Earth Spirit's seat, eight bian on the left and eight dou on the right; one deng between bian and dou; one fu and one gui before the deng; one libation stand before the spirit seat.

units.zh: 又設第二等諸神位每位籩二、豆二、簠一、簋一、俎一、爵坫一。
units.en: Each second-tier spirit received two bian, two dou, one fu, one gui, one zuo, and one libation stand.
units.literal: For each spirit seat of the second tier, two bian, two dou, one fu, one gui, one zuo, and one libation stand.

units.zh: 內濆之內外諸神每位籩一、豆一、簠一、簋一、俎一、爵坫一。
units.en: Each spirit inside and outside the inner embankment received one bian, one dou, one fu, one gui, one zuo, and one libation stand.
units.literal: For each spirit inside and outside the inner embankment, one bian, one dou, one fu, one gui, one zuo, and one libation stand.

units.zh: 陳列皆與上同。
units.en: Offerings were arranged as above.
units.literal: The arrangement of offerings was the same as above.

units.zh: 又設神州地祇太尊二、著尊二，皆有坫。
units.en: They also set two Grand Vessels and two Display Vessels for Spirit State Earth, each on a stand.
units.literal: They also set two Grand Vessels and two Display Vessels for Spirit State Earth Spirit, each with a stand.

units.zh: 第二等諸神每方山尊二，內濆內每方蜃尊二，內濆外每方概尊二，皆加勺、冪。
units.en: Second-tier spirits had two Mountain Vessels per direction; within the inner embankment, two Clam Vessels per direction; outside it, two Catalpa Vessels per direction—all with ladles and covers.
units.literal: For spirits of the second tier, two Mountain Vessels per direction; inside the inner embankment, two Clam Vessels per direction; outside the inner embankment, two Catalpa Vessels per direction—all with ladles and covers.

units.zh: 又設正、配位籩一、豆一、簠一、簋一、俎三、及毛血豆一、並神州地祇位俎一，各於饌冪內。
units.en: Inside the food canopy they also placed for the principal and consort one bian, one dou, one fu, one gui, three zuo, and one hair-and-blood dou, and one zuo for Spirit State Earth.
units.literal: They also set for the principal and consort seats one bian, one dou, one fu, one gui, three zuo, and one hair-and-blood dou, and one zuo for Spirit State Earth Spirit's seat—each inside the food canopy.

units.zh: 又設二洗於壇下卯陛之東，北向，盥洗在東，爵洗在西，並有罍加勺。
units.en: East of the mao ascent below the altar they set two washing stations, facing north—hand-washing east, cup-washing west—each with jar and ladle.
units.literal: They also set two washing stations east of the mao ascent below the altar, north-facing: hand-washing in the east, libation-cup washing in the west, each with a jar and ladle.

units.zh: 篚在洗西，南肆，實以巾。
units.en: Baskets stood west of the washing stations, displayed southward, filled with cloths.
units.literal: Baskets were west of the washing stations, displayed to the south, filled with cloths.

units.zh: 爵洗之篚實以匏爵，加坫。
units.en: The cup-washing basket held gourd libation cups on stands.
units.literal: The basket at the libation-cup washing station held gourd libation cups on stands.

units.zh: 又設第一等分獻官盥洗爵洗位，第二等以下分獻官盥洗位，各于其方道之左，罍在洗左，篚在洗右，俱內向。
units.en: First-grade distributed offerers received hand- and cup-washing stations; second-grade and below, hand-washing only—each to the left of its directional path, jar on the left, basket on the right, all facing inward.
units.literal: They also set hand-washing and libation-cup washing stations for first-grade distributed offering officials, and hand-washing stations for second-grade and below—each to the left of its direction's path, jar left of the washing station, basket right, all facing inward.

units.zh: 執罍篚者各於其後。
units.en: Jar- and basket-bearers each stood behind their station.
units.literal: Those holding jars and baskets each stood behind their station.

units.zh: 祭日醜前五刻，司天監、郊社令帥其屬，升設皇地祇及配位神座於壇上，設神州地祇座於第一等。
units.en: On the day of sacrifice, five quarters before the chou hour, the Directorate of Astronomy and the suburban altar director led their staffs up to set Imperial Earth and the consort on the altar and Spirit State Earth on the first tier.
units.literal: On the sacrifice day, five quarters before the chou hour, the Directorate of Astronomy and the suburban altar director led their subordinates up to set the spirit seats of August Earth Spirit and the consort on the altar, and Spirit State Earth Spirit's seat on the first tier.

units.zh: 又設玉幣，皇地祇玉以黃琮，神州地祇玉以兩圭有邸，皆置於匣。
units.en: They also set jade and silks—yellow cong for Imperial Earth, paired gui with bases for Spirit State Earth—all in cases.
units.literal: They also set jade and silks: for August Earth Spirit, yellow cong jade; for Spirit State Earth Spirit, paired gui with bases—all placed in cases.

units.zh: 正、配位幣並以黃色，神州地祇幣以玄色，五神、五官、嶽鎮海瀆之幣各從其方色，皆陳於篚。
units.en: Silks for the principal and consort were yellow; for Spirit State Earth, black; for the Five Spirits, Five Officials, marchmounts, garrisons, seas, and streams, each its directional color—all laid in baskets.
units.literal: Silks for the principal and consort seats were all yellow; for Spirit State Earth Spirit, black; for the Five Spirits, Five Officials, marchmounts, garrisons, seas, and streams, each followed its directional color—all displayed in baskets.

units.zh: 太祝取瘞玉加于幣，於禮神之玉各置於神座前。
units.en: The grand invoker took burial jade and set it with the silks; the jade for honoring each spirit was placed before its seat.
units.literal: The grand invoker took burial jade and added it to the silks; the jade for honoring the spirits was each placed before its spirit seat.

units.zh: 光祿卿帥其屬，入實正、配位籩豆。
units.en: The Director of Imperial Victuals and his staff filled the bian and dou at the principal and consort seats.
units.literal: The Director of Imperial Victuals led his subordinates in to fill the bian and dou at the principal and consort seats.

units.zh: 籩三行以右為上，豆三行以左為上，其實並如郊祀。
units.en: Three rows of bian ranked from the right, three of dou from the left—their contents as at suburban sacrifice.
units.literal: The three rows of bian ranked from the right upward; the three rows of dou from the left upward—their contents as at suburban sacrifice.

units.zh: 登實以大羹，鉶實以和羹。
units.en: The deng held great broth; the xing, seasoned broth.
units.literal: The deng were filled with great broth; the xing with seasoned broth.

units.zh: 又設從祭第一等神州地祇之饌。
units.en: They also set the first-grade attendant offerings for Spirit State Earth.
units.literal: They also set the food offerings for the first-grade attendant sacrifice to Spirit State Earth Spirit.

units.zh: 籩三行以右為上，豆三行以左為上，其實並如郊祀。
units.en: Three rows of bian ranked from the right, three of dou from the left—their contents as at suburban sacrifice.
units.literal: Three rows of bian ranked from the right upward; three rows of dou from the left upward—their contents as at suburban sacrifice.

units.zh: 登實以大羹，簠實以稷，簋實以黍。
units.en: The deng held great broth; the fu, millet; the gui, panicled millet.
units.literal: The deng were filled with great broth; the fu with millet; the gui with panicled millet.

units.zh: 第二等每位，左二籩，栗在前，鹿脯次之。
units.en: Each second-tier seat had two bian on the left—chestnuts first, then dried venison.
units.literal: For each second-tier seat, two bian on the left—chestnuts first, then dried venison.

units.zh: 右二豆，菁菹在前，鹿臡次之。
units.en: Two dou on the right—pickled greens first, then minced venison.
units.literal: Two dou on the right—pickled greens first, then minced venison.

units.zh: 簠實以稷，簋實以黍。
units.en: The fu held millet; the gui, panicled millet.
units.literal: The fu were filled with millet; the gui with panicled millet.

units.zh: 俎，一羊、一豕。
units.en: On the zuo, one sheep and one pig.
units.literal: For the zuo, one sheep and one pig.

units.zh: 內濆內外每位，左籩一，鹿脯。
units.en: Each seat inside and outside the inner embankment had one bian on the left with dried venison.
units.literal: For each seat inside and outside the inner embankment, one bian on the left with dried venison.

units.zh: 右豆一，鹿臡。
units.en: One dou on the right with minced venison.
units.literal: One dou on the right with minced venison.

units.zh: 簠稷，簋黍，俎以羊。
units.en: Fu with millet, gui with panicled millet, zuo with sheep.
units.literal: Fu with millet, gui with panicled millet, zuo with sheep.

units.zh: 良醖令帥其屬，入實酒尊。
units.en: The Chief Brewer and his staff filled the wine vessels.
units.literal: The Chief Brewer led his subordinates in to fill the wine vessels.

units.zh: 皇地祇太尊為上，實以泛齊。
units.en: For Imperial Earth, the Grand Vessel ranked highest, filled with fan qi wine.
units.literal: For August Earth Spirit, the Grand Vessel was highest, filled with fan qi wine.

units.zh: 著尊次之，實以醴齊。
units.en: The Display Vessel came next, filled with li qi wine.
units.literal: The Display Vessel was next, filled with li qi wine.

units.zh: 犧尊次之，實以盎齊。
units.en: The Sacrificial Vessel came next, filled with ang qi wine.
units.literal: The Sacrificial Vessel was next, filled with ang qi wine.

units.zh: 象尊次之，實以醍齊。
units.en: The Elephant Vessel came next, filled with ti qi wine.
units.literal: The Elephant Vessel was next, filled with ti qi wine.

units.zh: 壺尊次之，實以沈齊。
units.en: The Pot Vessel came next, filled with chen qi wine.
units.literal: The Pot Vessel was next, filled with chen qi wine.

units.zh: 山罍為下，實以三酒。
units.en: The Mountain Jar ranked lowest, filled with the three wines.
units.literal: The Mountain Jar was lowest, filled with the three wines.

units.zh: 配位，著尊為上，實以泛齊。
units.en: For the consort, the Display Vessel ranked highest, filled with fan qi wine.
units.literal: For the consort seat, the Display Vessel was highest, filled with fan qi wine.

units.zh: 犧尊次之，實以醴齊。
units.en: The Sacrificial Vessel came next, filled with li qi wine.
units.literal: The Sacrificial Vessel was next, filled with li qi wine.

units.zh: 象奠次之，實以盎齊。
units.en: The Elephant Vessel came next, filled with ang qi wine.
units.literal: The Elephant Vessel was next, filled with ang qi wine.

units.zh: 壺尊次之，實以醍齊，山罍為下，實以三酒。
units.en: The Pot Vessel came next with ti qi wine; the Mountain Jar ranked lowest with the three wines.
units.literal: The Pot Vessel was next, filled with ti qi wine; the Mountain Jar was lowest, filled with the three wines.

units.zh: 皆左實明水，右實玄酒，皆尚醖代。
units.en: Each had clear water left and dark wine right, honoring the brewer's stock.
units.literal: All had clear water on the left and dark wine on the right, all honoring the brewer's generation.

units.zh: 次實從祭第一等神州地祇酒尊，太尊為上，實以泛齊。
units.en: Next they filled the wine vessels for Spirit State Earth's first-grade attendant sacrifice—the Grand Vessel highest with fan qi wine.
units.literal: Next they filled the wine vessels for the first-grade attendant sacrifice to Spirit State Earth Spirit; the Grand Vessel was highest, filled with fan qi wine.

units.zh: 著尊次之，實以醴齊。
units.en: The Display Vessel came next with li qi wine.
units.literal: The Display Vessel was next, filled with li qi wine.

units.zh: 第二等，山尊實以醍齊。
units.en: Second-tier Mountain Vessels held ti qi wine.
units.literal: For the second tier, Mountain Vessels were filled with ti qi wine.

units.zh: 內濆內，蜃尊實以泛齊。
units.en: Within the inner embankment, Clam Vessels held fan qi wine.
units.literal: Inside the inner embankment, Clam Vessels were filled with fan qi wine.

units.zh: 內濆外，概尊實以三酒。
units.en: Outside the inner embankment, Catalpa Vessels held the three wines.
units.literal: Outside the inner embankment, Catalpa Vessels were filled with the three wines.

units.zh: 以上尊皆左以明水，右以玄酒，皆尚醖代之。
units.en: All vessels above had clear water left and dark wine right, honoring the brewer's stock.
units.literal: For all the vessels above, clear water was on the left and dark wine on the right, all honoring the brewer's generation.

units.zh: 太常卿設燭於神座前。
units.en: The Director of Grand Harmony set candles before each spirit seat.
units.literal: The Director of Grand Harmony set candles before the spirit seats.

units.zh: 省牲器：祭前一日午後八刻，去壇二百步禁止行者。
units.en: Inspecting victims and vessels: on the eve of sacrifice, at the eighth quarter after noon, no one might pass within two hundred paces of the altar.
units.literal: Inspecting victims and vessels: on the day before the sacrifice, at the eighth quarter after noon, within two hundred paces of the altar travelers were forbidden.

units.zh: 未後二刻，郊社令帥其屬，掃除壇之上下。
units.en: At the second wei quarter the suburban altar director and his staff swept the altar clean.
units.literal: At the second quarter of wei, the suburban altar director led his subordinates to sweep above and below the altar.

units.zh: 司尊與奉禮郎，帥執事者以祭器入，設於位。
units.en: The vessel keeper and ritual attendants led the executives to bring in the ritual gear and set it in place.
units.literal: The Keeper of Ritual Vessels and the ritual attendant led the executive officers to bring in the ritual vessels and set them at their stations.

units.zh: 郊社令陳玉幣於篚。
units.en: The suburban altar director laid out jade and silks in baskets.
units.literal: The suburban altar director displayed jade and silks in baskets.

units.zh: 未後三刻，廩犧令與諸太祝、祝史，以牲就省位。
units.en: At the third wei quarter the granary officer, grand invokers, and scribes brought the victims to the inspection station.
units.literal: At the third quarter of wei, the Granary and Victuals director with the grand invokers and invoker scribes brought the victims to the inspection station.

units.zh: 禮直官、贊者分引太常卿，光祿卿、丞、監禮、祭，太官令等詣內壝東門外省牲位。
units.en: Ritual attendants and presenters then led the Director of Grand Harmony, the Director of Imperial Victuals and his aide, the supervising ritual academician and censor, the kitchen director, and others to the victim-inspection station outside the inner embankment's east gate.
units.literal: Ritual attendants and presenters in turn led the Director of Grand Harmony, the Director of Imperial Victuals and his aide, the supervising ritual academician, the supervising censor, the Imperial Kitchen director, and others to the outer victim station east of the inner embankment's gate.

units.zh: 其視滌濯、告潔、省牲饌，並同郊祀。
units.en: Inspecting the washing, announcing purity, and inspecting victims and offerings—all followed suburban sacrifice.
units.literal: Inspecting washing, announcing purity, and inspecting victims and food—all were the same as at suburban sacrifice.

units.zh: 俱畢，廩犧令、諸太祝、祝史以次牽牲詣廚，授太官令。
units.en: When finished, the granary officer, grand invokers, and scribes led the victims in turn to the kitchen and handed them to the kitchen director.
units.literal: When all was finished, the Granary and Victuals director, grand invokers, and invoker scribes in turn led the victims to the kitchen and handed them to the Imperial Kitchen director.

units.zh: 次引光祿卿以下詣廚，省鼎鑊，視滌溉，乃還齋所。
units.en: Next they led the Director of Imperial Victuals and his staff to the kitchen to inspect the cauldrons and washing, then back to the abstinence quarters.
units.literal: Next they led the Director of Imperial Victuals and those below to the kitchen to inspect the cauldrons and view the washing; then they returned to the abstinence quarters.

units.zh: 晡後一刻，太官令帥宰人以鸞刀割牲，祝史各取毛血，實以豆，置於饌幔。
units.en: One quarter after shen, the kitchen director's butchers cut the victims with the phoenix knife; each scribe took hair and blood, filled dou vessels, and set them in the food canopy.
units.literal: One quarter after the shen hour, the Imperial Kitchen director led butchers to cut the victims with the phoenix knife; each invoker scribe took hair and blood, filled dou vessels, and placed them in the food canopy.

units.zh: 遂烹牲，又祝史取瘞血貯於盤。
units.en: They then cooked the victims; scribes also collected burial blood in trays.
units.literal: They then cooked the victims; invoker scribes also took burial blood and stored it in trays.

units.zh: 奠玉幣：祭日醜前五刻，獻官以下行事官，各服其服。
units.en: Presenting jade and silks: On the day of sacrifice, five quarters before the chou hour, every offerer and ritual officer wore full dress.
units.literal: Presenting jade and silks: On the sacrifice day, five quarters before the chou hour, the offering officials and all ritual officers below them each wore proper dress.

units.zh: 有司設神位版，陳玉幣，實籩豆簠簋奠罍，俟監祭、監禮按視壇之上下，乃徹去蓋冪。
units.en: Officers set the tablets, displayed jade and silks, filled the vessels, and waited for the supervising censor and ritual academician to inspect the altar—then removed the covers.
units.literal: The responsible offices set spirit tablets, displayed jade and silks, filled bian, dou, fu, gui, and offering jars, and awaited the supervising censor and supervising ritual academician to inspect above and below the altar—then removed covers.

units.zh: 大樂令帥工人，及奉禮郎、贊者先入。
units.en: The Grand Music director, craftsmen, attendants, and presenters entered first.
units.literal: The Grand Music director led the craftsmen, ritual attendants, and presenters to enter first.

units.zh: 禮直官、贊者分引分獻官以下，監祭、監禮、諸大祝、祝史、齋郎與執事者，入自南濆東門，當壇南，重行，北向，西上，立定。
units.en: Attendants and presenters led distributed offerers and all below, the supervising censor and academician, invokers, scribes, abstinence officers, and executives in through the south embankment's east gate, south of the altar, double-ranked and facing north from the west, and stood fast.
units.literal: Ritual attendants and presenters in turn led distributed offering officials and those below, the supervising censor and ritual academician, all grand invokers, invoker scribes, abstinence officers, and executives—they entered by the south embankment's east gate, south of the altar, double-ranked, north-facing, ranked from the west upward, and stood in place.

units.zh: 奉禮郎贊：「拜。」
units.en: The attendant called: "Bow."
units.literal: The ritual attendant announced: "Bow."

units.zh: 獻官以下皆再拜，訖，以次分引各就壇陛上下位。
units.en: Every offerer bowed twice; then each was led to his place on or below the altar steps.
units.literal: All offering officials and those below bowed twice; when done, they were led in turn each to his station on or below the altar steps.

units.zh: 次引監祭、監禮按視壇之上下，訖，退復位。
units.en: Next the supervising censor and ritual academician inspected the altar; when done, they withdrew to their stations.
units.literal: Next they led the supervising censor and supervising ritual academician to inspect above and below the altar; when finished, they withdrew and returned to station.

units.zh: 禮直官分引三獻官以下行事官俱入就位。
units.en: Attendants led the three offerers and all ritual officers in to take their places.
units.literal: Ritual attendants in turn led the three offering officials and all ritual officers below them to enter and take station.

units.zh: 行禮官皆自南濆東門入。
units.en: All ritual officers entered through the south embankment's east gate.
units.literal: All ritual officers entered by the south embankment's east gate.

units.zh: 禮直官進立初獻之左，白曰：「有司謹具，請行事。」
units.en: The attendant stepped to the initial offerer's left and said: "All is prepared; please proceed with the rite."
units.literal: The ritual attendant advanced and stood to the initial offerer's left, reporting: "The responsible offices have duly prepared; please proceed with the rite."

units.zh: 退復位。
units.en: He withdrew to his station.
units.literal: He withdrew and returned to station.

units.zh: 協律郎高舉笏，執麾者舉麾，俯伏，興。
units.en: The pitch officer raised his tablet; the banner-bearer raised the banner; all prostrated and rose.
units.literal: The pitch officer raised his tablet high; the banner-bearer raised the banner; all prostrated and rose.

units.zh: 工鼓柷，樂作《坤甯之曲》，八成，偃麾，戛敔，樂止。
units.en: Craftsmen struck the block; the "Kunning" piece played through eight sections; the banner fell, the clapper sounded, and the music ceased.
units.literal: The craftsmen struck the sounding-block; music began—the "Kunning" piece in eight sections; the banner was lowered, the wooden clapper sounded, and the music stopped.

units.zh: 俟太常卿瘞血，訖，奉禮郎贊：「拜。」
units.en: When the Director of Grand Harmony had buried the blood, the attendant called: "Bow."
units.literal: When the Director of Grand Harmony had buried the blood and finished, the ritual attendant announced: "Bow."

units.zh: 在位者皆再拜。
units.en: All in station bowed twice.
units.literal: All in station bowed twice.

units.zh: 又贊：「諸執事者各就位。」
units.en: He called again: "All executives, to your stations."
units.literal: He again announced: "All executive officers, each to your station."

units.zh: 禮直官引諸執事各就其位俟。
units.en: Attendants led each executive to his station to wait.
units.literal: Ritual attendants led the executive officers each to his station to await.

units.zh: 太祝跪取玉幣於篚，立於尊所。
units.en: The grand invoker knelt, took jade and silks from the basket, and stood at the wine station.
units.literal: The grand invoker knelt, took jade and silks from the basket, and stood at the wine-vessel station.

units.zh: 諸位太祝亦各取玉幣立於奠所。
units.en: Grand invokers at each seat likewise took jade and silks and stood at their offering stations.
units.literal: Grand invokers at each seat likewise each took jade and silks and stood at the offering station.

units.zh: 禮直官引初獻詣盥洗位，樂作《肅甯之曲》。
units.en: The attendant led the initial offerer to the hand-washing station as the "Suning" piece began.
units.literal: The ritual attendant led the initial offerer to the hand-washing station; music began—the "Suning" piece.

units.zh: 至位，北向立，樂止。
units.en: At his station he stood facing north; the music stopped.
units.literal: When he reached his station he stood north-facing; the music stopped.

units.zh: 搢笏，盥手，帨手，執笏，詣壇，樂作《肅甯之曲》。
units.en: He tucked his tablet, washed and dried his hands, took up his tablet, and went to the altar as the "Suning" piece played.
units.literal: He inserted his tablet, washed his hands, dried them, took up his tablet, and proceeded to the altar; music began—the "Suning" piece.

units.zh: 凡初獻升降，皆作《肅甯之曲》。
units.en: Whenever the initial offerer went up or down, the "Suning" piece played.
units.literal: Whenever the initial offerer ascended or descended, the "Suning" piece was performed.

units.zh: 升自卯階，至壇，樂止。
units.en: He climbed the mao steps to the altar; the music stopped.
units.literal: He ascended by the mao steps to the altar; the music stopped.

units.zh: 詣皇地祇神座前，北向立，樂作《靜甯之曲》。
units.en: He came before Imperial Earth's seat and stood facing north as the "Jingning" piece began.
units.literal: He proceeded before August Earth Spirit's seat, stood north-facing; music began—the "Jingning" piece.

units.zh: 搢笏，跪。
units.en: He tucked his tablet and knelt.
units.literal: He inserted his tablet and knelt.

units.zh: 太祝加玉於幣，西向跪以授初獻。
units.en: The grand invoker set jade with the silks and, kneeling west, handed them to the initial offerer.
units.literal: The grand invoker added jade to the silks and, kneeling west-facing, presented them to the initial offerer.

units.zh: 初獻受玉幣奠訖，執笏，俯伏，興，再拜，訖，樂止。
units.en: The initial offerer received and presented the jade and silks, then took up his tablet, prostrated, rose, bowed twice, and finished; the music ceased.
units.literal: The initial offerer received the jade and silks and presented them; when done he took up his tablet, prostrated, rose, bowed twice, and finished; the music stopped.

units.zh: 次詣配位神座前，東向立，樂作《億甯之曲》，奠幣如上儀，樂止。
units.en: Next he came before the consort's seat, facing east, as the "Yining" piece played; he presented silks by the same rite; the music ceased.
units.literal: Next he proceeded before the consort spirit seat, stood east-facing; music began—the "Yining" piece; he presented silks by the same protocol; the music stopped.

units.zh: 降自卯陛，樂作，復位，樂止。
units.en: He descended the mao ascent to music, returned to his station, and the music ceased.
units.literal: He descended by the mao ascent; music began; he returned to station; the music stopped.

units.zh: 初獻將奠配位之幣，贊者引第一等分獻官詣盥洗位，搢笏，盥手，帨手，執笏，由卯陛詣神州地祇神座前，搢笏，跪。
units.en: As the initial offerer was about to present at the consort seat, the presenter led the first-grade distributed offerer to wash, then up the mao steps to Spirit State Earth's seat, where he knelt.
units.literal: As the initial offerer was about to present silks at the consort seat, the presenter led the first-grade distributed offering official to the hand-washing station; he inserted his tablet, washed and dried his hands, took up his tablet, ascended by the mao steps to Spirit State Earth Spirit's seat, inserted his tablet, and knelt.

units.zh: 太祝以玉幣授分獻官，分獻官受玉幣，奠訖，執笏，俯伏，興，再拜，訖，退。
units.en: The grand invoker handed him jade and silks; he presented them, prostrated, rose, bowed twice, and withdrew.
units.literal: The grand invoker handed jade and silks to the distributed offering official; he received them, presented them, took up his tablet, prostrated, rose, bowed twice, finished, and withdrew.

units.zh: 初，第一分獻官將升，贊者引第二分獻官詣盥洗位，盥手、帨手，執笏，各由其陛升，唯不由午陛，詣於首位神座前，奠幣如上儀。
units.en: As the first distributed offerer was about to ascend, the presenter led the second to wash; each climbed by his own steps—not the wu steps—to the foremost seat and presented silks by the same rite.
units.literal: At the start, as the first distributed offering official was about to ascend, the presenter led the second to the hand-washing station; they washed and dried their hands, took up their tablets, each ascended by his own steps—only not by the wu steps—and proceeded to the foremost spirit seat to present silks by the same protocol.

units.zh: 余以次祝史、齋郎助奠訖，各引還位。
units.en: Remaining scribes and abstinence officers assisted in turn, then each was led back to station.
units.literal: The remaining invoker scribes and abstinence officers in turn assisted with the presentations; each was led back to station.

units.zh: 初獻奠幣將畢，祝史奉毛血豆，各由午陛升，諸太祝迎於壇上，進奠於正、配位神座前，太祝與祝史俱退，立於尊所。
units.en: As the initial offerer neared the end of presenting silks, scribes bore the hair-and-blood dou up the wu steps; grand invokers met them on the altar and presented before the principal and consort; then all withdrew to the wine station.
units.literal: As the initial offerer's presentation of silks was nearly finished, invoker scribes bore the hair-and-blood dou, each ascending by the wu steps; grand invokers met them on the altar and advanced to present before the principal and consort seats; grand invokers and scribes all withdrew and stood at the wine-vessel station.

units.zh: 進熟：初獻既升奠玉幣。
units.en: Presenting the cooked offerings: once the initial offerer had presented jade and silks.
units.literal: Presenting the cooked offerings: after the initial offerer had ascended and presented jade and silks.

units.zh: 有司先陳牛鼎二、羊鼎二、豕鼎二於神廚，各在鑊右。
units.en: Officers first set out two ox, two sheep, and two pig tripods in the spirit kitchen, each beside its cauldron.
units.literal: The responsible offices first set out two ox tripods, two sheep tripods, and two pig tripods in the spirit kitchen, each to the right of its cauldron.

units.zh: 太官帥進饌者詣廚，以匕升牛、羊、豕，自鑊實於各鼎。
units.en: The kitchen director led the food-bearers to the kitchen and ladled ox, sheep, and pig from the cauldrons into the tripods.
units.literal: The Imperial Kitchen director led those bringing food to the kitchen; with ladles they lifted ox, sheep, and pig from the cauldrons into the respective tripods.

units.zh: 牛、羊、豕各肩、臂、臑、肫、胳、正脊一、橫脊一、長脅一、短脅一、代脅一，皆二骨以並，冪之。
units.en: Ox, sheep, and pig each yielded shoulder, arm, shank, rump, rib, straight spine, cross spine, long and short flanks, and substitute flank—each cut paired on two bones and covered.
units.literal: For ox, sheep, and pig, each had shoulder, arm, shank, rump, rib, one straight spine, one cross spine, one long flank, one short flank, and one substitute flank—all paired on two bones and covered.

units.zh: 祝史以扃各對舉鼎，有司執匕以從，陳於饌幔內。
units.en: Scribes with poles lifted the tripods in pairs; officers with ladles followed and set them inside the food canopy.
units.literal: Invoker scribes with carrying-poles each lifted a tripod in pairs; responsible officers bore ladles and followed, setting them out inside the food canopy.

units.zh: 從祀之俎實以羊，更陳於饌幔內。
units.en: Attendant zuo filled with sheep were laid out again inside the food canopy.
units.literal: Zuo for attendant sacrifice were filled with sheep and set out again inside the food canopy.

units.zh: 光祿卿實以籩豆簠簋。
units.en: The Director of Imperial Victuals filled the bian, dou, fu, and gui.
units.literal: The Director of Imperial Victuals filled the bian, dou, fu, and gui.

units.zh: 籩實以粉餈，豆實以糝食，簠實以稷，簋實以黍。
units.en: Bian held powdered cakes; dou, seasoned grain; fu, millet; gui, panicled millet.
units.literal: Bian were filled with powdered cakes; dou with seasoned grain; fu with millet; gui with panicled millet.

units.zh: 實訖，去鼎之扃冪，匕加於鼎。
units.en: When filling was done, the bars and covers came off and ladles were set on the tripods.
units.literal: When filling was finished, the tripod bars and covers were removed and ladles placed on the tripods.

units.zh: 太官令以匕升牛羊豕，載於俎，肩臂臑在上端，肫胳在下端，脊脅在中。
units.en: The kitchen director ladled ox, sheep, and pig onto zuo—shoulder, arm, and shank above, rump and rib below, spine and flank in the middle.
units.literal: The Imperial Kitchen director with ladles lifted ox, sheep, and pig onto zuo—shoulder, arm, and shank at the upper end, rump and rib at the lower, spine and flank in the middle.

units.zh: 俟初獻還位，樂止。
units.en: They waited until the initial offerer returned to station; the music ceased.
units.literal: They awaited the initial offerer's return to station; the music stopped.

units.zh: 禮直官引司徒出詣饌所，同薦籩豆簠簋俎。
units.en: The attendant led the Minister of Education to the food station to present the bian, dou, fu, gui, and zuo together.
units.literal: The ritual attendant led the Minister of Education out to the food station to present together the bian, dou, fu, gui, and zuo.

units.zh: 齋郎各奉皇地祇配位之饌，升自卯陛，諸太祝各迎於壇上。
units.en: Abstinence officers bore the offerings for Imperial Earth and the consort up the mao steps; grand invokers met them on the altar.
units.literal: Abstinence officers each bore the food for August Earth Spirit and the consort, ascending by the mao steps; grand invokers each met them on the altar.

units.zh: 司徒詣皇地祇神座前，搢笏，奉籩豆簠簋，次奉俎，北向跪奠，訖，執笏，俯伏，興，設籩於糗餌之前，豆於醓醢之前，簠簋在登前，俎在籩前。
units.en: The Minister of Education came before Imperial Earth's seat, presented bian, dou, fu, and gui, then the zuo, kneeling north; he prostrated and rose, placing bian before the grain cakes, dou before the pickles, fu and gui before the deng, zuo before the bian.
units.literal: The Minister of Education proceeded before August Earth Spirit's seat, inserted his tablet, bore bian, dou, fu, and gui, then bore the zuo; kneeling north-facing he presented them; when done he took up his tablet, prostrated, and rose—setting bian before the grain cakes, dou before the pickled sauces, fu and gui before the deng, zuo before the bian.

units.zh: 次於卯陛奉配位之饌，東向跪奠於神座前，並如上儀。
units.en: Next he bore the consort's food from the mao ascent, knelt facing east, and presented before the seat by the same rite.
units.literal: Next, from the mao ascent he bore the consort's food, knelt east-facing, and presented before the spirit seat—all by the same protocol.

units.zh: 各降自卯陛，還位。
units.en: Each descended the mao ascent and returned to station.
units.literal: Each descended by the mao ascent and returned to station.

units.zh: 太官令又同齋郎奉神州地祇之饌，升自卯陛，太祝迎於壇陛之道間，奠於神座前，在籩前，訖，樂止。
units.en: The kitchen director and abstinence officers bore Spirit State Earth's food up the mao steps; the grand invoker met them on the path and presented before the seat, before the bian; the music ceased.
units.literal: The Imperial Kitchen director again with abstinence officers bore Spirit State Earth Spirit's food, ascending by the mao steps; the grand invoker met them on the path between altar and steps and presented before the spirit seat, before the bian; when finished the music stopped.

units.zh: 太官令進饌者降自卯陛，還位。
units.en: The kitchen director and food-bearers descended the mao ascent and returned to station.
units.literal: The Imperial Kitchen director and those bringing food descended by the mao ascent and returned to station.

units.zh: 禮直官引初獻官詣盥洗位，樂作。
units.en: The attendant led the initial offerer to the hand-washing station as music began.
units.literal: The ritual attendant led the initial offering official to the hand-washing station; music began.

units.zh: 至位，樂止。
units.en: At his station the music ceased.
units.literal: When he reached his station the music stopped.

units.zh: 北向立，搢笏，盥手、帨手，執笏，詣爵洗位。
units.en: Facing north, he washed and dried his hands, then went to the cup-washing station.
units.literal: Standing north-facing, he inserted his tablet, washed and dried his hands, took up his tablet, and proceeded to the cup-washing station.

units.zh: 至位，北向立，搢笏，洗爵，拭爵以授執事者。
units.en: At the station he washed and dried the cup and handed it to an attendant.
units.literal: At his station he stood north-facing, inserted his tablet, washed the cup, dried it, and handed it to an attendant.

units.zh: 執笏，詣壇，樂作。
units.en: Tablet in hand, he went to the altar as music began.
units.literal: He took up his tablet and proceeded to the altar; music began.

units.zh: 升自卯陛，至壇上，樂止。
units.en: He climbed the mao steps to the altar; the music ceased.
units.literal: He ascended by the mao steps to the top of the altar; the music stopped.

units.zh: 詣皇地祇酌尊所，西向立。
units.en: He came to Imperial Earth's libation station and stood facing west.
units.literal: He proceeded to August Earth Spirit's libation station and stood west-facing.

units.zh: 執事者以爵授初獻。
units.en: An attendant handed the cup to the initial offerer.
units.literal: An attendant handed the cup to the initial offerer.

units.zh: 初獻搢笏，執爵。
units.en: The initial offerer tucked his tablet and took the cup.
units.literal: The initial offerer inserted his tablet and took the cup.

units.zh: 司尊舉冪，良醖令跪酌太尊之泛齊，酌訖，初獻以爵授執事者，執笏，詣皇地祇神座前，北向立，搢笏，跪。
units.en: The vessel keeper raised the cover; the brewer knelt and poured fan qi from the Grand Vessel; the initial offerer handed back the cup, went before Imperial Earth's seat, and knelt facing north.
units.literal: The Keeper of Ritual Vessels raised the cover; the Chief Brewer knelt and poured fan qi from the Grand Vessel; when pouring was done the initial offerer handed the cup to an attendant, took up his tablet, proceeded before August Earth Spirit's seat, stood north-facing, inserted his tablet, and knelt.

units.zh: 執事者以爵授初獻，初獻執爵，三祭酒于茅苴，奠爵，三獻奠爵，皆執事者受以興。
units.en: An attendant handed him the cup; he poured libation three times on the thatch and placed the cup; the three offerers each placed their cups—attendants received them and rose.
units.literal: An attendant handed the cup to the initial offerer; he held the cup, poured libation three times on the thatch, placed the cup; the three offerers placed their cups—all were received by attendants who rose.

units.zh: 執笏，俯伏，興，少退，跪，樂止。
units.en: He took up his tablet, prostrated, rose, withdrew slightly, and knelt; the music ceased.
units.literal: He took up his tablet, prostrated, rose, withdrew slightly, knelt; the music stopped.

units.zh: 舉祝官跪，對舉祝版。
units.en: The invocation officer knelt and raised the invocation tablet before him.
units.literal: The invocation officer knelt and raised the invocation tablet facing him.

units.zh: 讀祝，太祝東向跪，讀祝訖，俯伏，興。
units.en: The grand invoker knelt facing east, read the invocation, prostrated, and rose.
units.literal: The invocation was read; the grand invoker knelt east-facing, read the invocation to the end, prostrated, and rose.

units.zh: 舉祝奠版於案，再拜，興。
units.en: The invocation officer set the tablet on the table, bowed twice, and rose.
units.literal: The invocation officer placed the tablet on the table, bowed twice, and rose.

units.zh: 次詣配位酌尊所，執事者以爵授初獻，初獻搢笏，執爵。
units.en: Next he came to the consort's libation station; an attendant handed him the cup.
units.literal: Next he proceeded to the consort's libation station; an attendant handed the cup to the initial offerer, who inserted his tablet and took the cup.

units.zh: 司尊舉冪，良醖令跪酌著尊之泛齊，樂作太簇宮《保甯之曲》。
units.en: The vessel keeper raised the cover; the brewer knelt and poured fan qi from the Display Vessel as the "Baoning" piece played in Taicu mode.
units.literal: The Keeper of Ritual Vessels raised the cover; the Chief Brewer knelt and poured fan qi from the Display Vessel; music began—the "Baoning" piece in the Taicu mode.

units.zh: 初獻以爵授執事者，執笏，詣配位神座前，東向立，搢笏，跪。
units.en: He handed back the cup, went before the consort's seat, and knelt facing east.
units.literal: The initial offerer handed the cup to an attendant, took up his tablet, proceeded before the consort spirit seat, stood east-facing, inserted his tablet, and knelt.

units.zh: 執事者以爵授初獻，初獻執爵，三奠酒于茅苴。
units.en: An attendant handed him the cup; he poured wine three times on the thatch.
units.literal: An attendant handed the cup to the initial offerer; he held the cup and poured wine three times on the thatch.

units.zh: 奠爵，執笏，俯伏，興。
units.en: He placed the cup, prostrated, and rose.
units.literal: He placed the cup, took up his tablet, prostrated, and rose.

units.zh: 少退，跪，樂止。
units.en: He withdrew slightly and knelt; the music ceased.
units.literal: He withdrew slightly, knelt; the music stopped.

units.zh: 讀祝，訖，樂作，就拜，興，拜，興。
units.en: The invocation was read; music began; he bowed from where he knelt, rose, bowed again, and rose.
units.literal: The invocation was read; when finished music began; he performed the proximate bow, rose, bowed, and rose.

units.zh: 降自卯陛，讀祝、舉祝官俱從，樂作，復位，樂止。
units.en: He descended the mao ascent, followed by the invocation reader and bearer; music played as he returned to station, then ceased.
units.literal: He descended by the mao ascent; the reader and bearer of the invocation tablet both followed; music began; he returned to station; the music stopped.

units.zh: 次引亞獻詣盥洗位，北向立，搢笏，盥手，帨手。
units.en: Next they led the secondary offerer to wash his hands, facing north.
units.literal: Next they led the secondary offerer to the hand-washing station; he stood north-facing, inserted his tablet, washed and dried his hands.

units.zh: 執笏，詣爵洗位，北向立，搢笏，洗爵，拭爵授執事者。
units.en: He went to the cup-washing station, washed and dried the cup, and handed it to an attendant.
units.literal: He took up his tablet, proceeded to the cup-washing station, stood north-facing, inserted his tablet, washed the cup, dried it, and handed it to an attendant.

units.zh: 執笏，升自卯陛，詣皇地祇酌尊所，西向立。
units.en: Tablet in hand, he climbed the mao steps to Imperial Earth's libation station and stood facing west.
units.literal: He took up his tablet, ascended by the mao steps, proceeded to August Earth Spirit's libation station, and stood west-facing.

units.zh: 執事者以爵授亞獻。
units.en: An attendant handed the cup to the secondary offerer.
units.literal: An attendant handed the cup to the secondary offerer.

units.zh: 亞獻搢笏執爵，司尊舉冪，良醖令酌著尊之醴齊，酌訖，以爵授執事者，執笏，詣皇地祇神座前，北向立，搢笏、跪。
units.en: The secondary offerer took the cup; the brewer poured li qi from the Display Vessel; he handed back the cup, went before Imperial Earth's seat, and knelt facing north.
units.literal: The secondary offerer inserted his tablet and took the cup; the Keeper of Ritual Vessels raised the cover; the Chief Brewer poured li qi from the Display Vessel; when pouring was done he handed the cup to an attendant, took up his tablet, proceeded before August Earth Spirit's seat, stood north-facing, inserted his tablet, and knelt.

units.zh: 執事以爵授亞獻，亞獻執爵，三祭酒于茅苴，奠爵，執笏，俯伏，興，少退，再拜。
units.en: An attendant handed him the cup; he poured libation three times on the thatch, placed the cup, prostrated, withdrew slightly, and bowed twice.
units.literal: An attendant handed the cup to the secondary offerer; he held the cup, poured libation three times on the thatch, placed the cup, took up his tablet, prostrated, rose, withdrew slightly, and bowed twice.

units.zh: 次詣配位酌獻如上儀，唯酌犧尊為異。
units.en: Next he presented at the consort seat by the same rite—only the Sacrificial Vessel was used for pouring.
units.literal: Next he proceeded to the consort seat for libation and presentation by the same protocol—only pouring from the Sacrificial Vessel was different.

units.zh: 樂止，降復位。
units.en: The music ceased; he descended and returned to station.
units.literal: The music stopped; he descended and returned to station.

units.zh: 次引終獻詣盥洗位，盥手，帨手，洗爵，拭爵，以爵授執事者，升壇。
units.en: Next they led the final offerer to wash his hands and cup, then ascend the altar.
units.literal: Next they led the final offerer to the hand-washing station; he washed and dried his hands, washed and dried the cup, handed it to an attendant, and ascended the altar.

units.zh: 正位，酌犧尊之盎齊，配位，酌象尊之醴齊，奠獻並如亞獻之儀。
units.en: At the principal seat he poured ang qi from the Sacrificial Vessel; at the consort, li qi from the Elephant Vessel—presenting by the secondary offerer's rite.
units.literal: At the principal seat he poured ang qi from the Sacrificial Vessel; at the consort seat, li qi from the Elephant Vessel—presentation all by the secondary offerer's protocol.

units.zh: 禮畢，降復位。
units.en: When the rite was done he descended and returned to station.
units.literal: When the rite was finished he descended and returned to station.

units.zh: 初，終獻將升，贊者引第一等分獻官詣盥洗位，搢笏，盥手，帨手，洗爵，拭爵，以爵授執事者。
units.en: As the final offerer was about to ascend, the presenter led the first-grade distributed offerer to wash his hands and cup.
units.literal: At the start, as the final offerer was about to ascend, the presenter led the first-grade distributed offering official to the hand-washing station; he inserted his tablet, washed and dried his hands, washed and dried the cup, and handed it to an attendant.

units.zh: 執笏，詣神州地祇酌尊所，搢笏，執事者以爵授獻官。
units.en: Tablet in hand, he came to Spirit State Earth's libation station; an attendant handed him the cup.
units.literal: He took up his tablet, proceeded to Spirit State Earth Spirit's libation station, inserted his tablet; an attendant handed the cup to the offering official.

units.zh: 獻官執爵，執事者酌太尊之泛齊，酌訖，以爵授執事者。
units.en: He held the cup while an attendant poured fan qi from the Grand Vessel, then handed the cup back.
units.literal: The offering official held the cup; an attendant poured fan qi from the Grand Vessel; when pouring was done he handed the cup to an attendant.

units.zh: 進詣神座前，搢笏，跪，執事者以爵授獻官，獻官執爵，三祭酒于茅苴，奠爵，俯伏，興，少退，跪，再拜，訖，還位。
units.en: He came before the seat, knelt, poured libation three times on the thatch, placed the cup, prostrated, bowed twice, and returned to station.
units.literal: He advanced before the spirit seat, inserted his tablet, and knelt; an attendant handed the cup; the offering official held the cup, poured libation three times on the thatch, placed the cup, prostrated, rose, withdrew slightly, knelt, bowed twice, finished, and returned to station.

units.zh: 初，第一等分獻官將升，贊者分引第二等分獻官詣盥洗位，搢笏，盥手，帨手，執笏詣酌尊所，執事以爵授分獻官，分獻酌以授執事者，進詣首位神座前，奠獻並如上儀。
units.en: As the first-grade distributed offerer was about to ascend, presenters led second-grade offerers to wash, pour, and present at the foremost seat by the same rite.
units.literal: At the start, as the first-grade distributed offering official was about to ascend, presenters in turn led second-grade distributed offering officials to the hand-washing station; they inserted their tablets, washed and dried their hands, took up their tablets, proceeded to the libation station; attendants handed cups; the distributed offerers poured and handed cups to attendants, advanced before the foremost spirit seat, and presented—all by the protocol above.

units.zh: 祝史、齋郎以次助奠，訖，各引還位。
units.en: Scribes and abstinence officers assisted in turn, then each was led back to station.
units.literal: Invoker scribes and abstinence officers in turn assisted with presentations; when finished each was led back to station.

units.zh: 諸獻俱畢，諸太祝進徹籩豆，籩豆各一，少移故處。
units.en: When all presentations were done, grand invokers removed one bian and one dou each, shifting them slightly from their places.
units.literal: When all presentations were finished, grand invokers advanced to remove the bian and dou—one bian and one dou each, shifted slightly from their former places.

units.zh: 樂作《豐甯之曲》，卒徹、樂止。
units.en: The "Fengning" piece played; when removal was complete the music ceased.
units.literal: Music began—the "Fengning" piece; when removal was complete the music stopped.

units.zh: 奉禮官贊曰：「賜胙。」
units.en: The attendant called: "Grant the sacrificial flesh."
units.literal: The ritual attendant announced: "Grant the sacrificial flesh."

units.zh: 眾官再拜，樂作，一成，止。
units.en: All officials bowed twice; music played one section and ceased.
units.literal: All officials bowed twice; music began, one section, and stopped.

units.zh: 初，送神樂止，引初獻官詣望瘞位，樂作太簇宮《肅甯之曲》，至位，南向立，樂止。
units.en: When the send-off music ceased, they led the initial offerer to gaze at the burial offering as the "Suning" piece played in Taicu mode; he stood facing south; the music ceased.
units.literal: At the start, when the music for sending off the spirits stopped, they led the initial offering official to the station for gazing at the burial offering; music began—the "Suning" piece in Taicu mode; when he reached his station he stood south-facing; the music stopped.

units.zh: 初，在位官將拜，諸太祝、祝史各奉篚進詣神座前，玉幣，從祭神州地祇以下，並以俎載牲體，並取黍稷飯爵酒，各由其陛降壇，北詣瘞坎，實於坎中，又以從祭之位禮幣皆從瘞，禮直官曰：「可瘞。」
units.en: As officials were about to bow, invokers bore baskets forward—jade and silks, and from Spirit State Earth down, victim flesh on zuo, with millet, rice, cups, and wine; each descended north to the burial pit and placed them inside, attendant silks included; the attendant said, "You may bury."
units.literal: At the start, as officials in station were about to bow, grand invokers and invoker scribes each bore baskets forward before the spirit seats—jade and silks; from attendant sacrifice to Spirit State Earth Spirit and below, all bore victim flesh on zuo, and took panicled millet, millet, rice, cups, and wine; each descended the altar by his steps, proceeded north to the burial pit, and placed them in the pit; silks from attendant seats were also buried; the ritual attendant said: "You may bury."

units.zh: 東西六行，置土半坎，禮直官贊：「禮畢。」
units.en: Six rows east and west half-filled the pit with earth; the attendant called: "The rite is finished."
units.literal: Six rows east and west placed earth halfway up the pit; the ritual attendant announced: "The rite is finished."

units.zh: 引初獻出，禮官贊者各引祭官及監祭、監禮、太祝以下，俱複壇南，北向立定，奉禮郎贊曰：「再拜。」
units.en: They led the initial offerer out; officers led sacrifice officials, the supervising censor and academician, and invokers back south of the altar, facing north; the attendant called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: They led the initial offerer out; ritual officers and presenters in turn led the sacrifice officials, supervising censor, supervising ritual academician, grand invokers, and those below—all back south of the altar, north-facing, standing in place; the ritual attendant announced: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 監祭以下皆再拜，訖，奉禮以下及工人以次出。
units.en: The supervising censor and all below bowed twice; then attendants, officers, and craftsmen withdrew in turn.
units.literal: The supervising censor and those below all bowed twice; when done, ritual attendants and those below, and craftsmen in turn, withdrew.

units.zh: 光祿卿以胙奉進，監祭、監禮展視。
units.en: The Director of Imperial Victuals presented the sacrificial flesh; the supervising censor and ritual academician inspected it.
units.literal: The Director of Imperial Victuals presented the sacrificial flesh; the supervising censor and supervising ritual academician inspected it.

units.zh: 其祝版燔於齋坊。
units.en: The invocation tablets were burned in the abstinence quarters.
units.literal: The invocation tablets were burned in the abstinence quarters.

units.zh: 朝日夕月儀
units.en: Ceremonial Protocol for Dawn and Lunar Rites
units.literal: Rites for Greeting the Sun and Seeing Off the Moon

units.zh: 齋戒、陳設、省牲器、奠玉幣、進熟，其節並如大祀之儀。
units.en: Purification, arrangements, victim inspection, jade and silks, and cooked offerings all followed the great-sacrifice protocol.
units.literal: Purification, arrangement of offerings, inspection of victims and vessels, presentation of jade and silks, and presenting cooked offerings—all followed the protocol of a great sacrifice.

units.zh: 朝日玉用青壁，夕月用白壁，幣皆如玉之色。
units.en: Dawn rites used green bi jade; lunar rites, white bi; silks matched the jade.
units.literal: For greeting the sun, green bi jade was used; for seeing off the moon, white bi; silks matched the jade colors.

units.zh: 牲各用羊一、豕一。
units.en: Each rite used one sheep and one pig.
units.literal: Victims were one sheep and one pig each.

units.zh: 有司攝三獻司徒行事。
units.en: Officers had the Minister of Education perform the three offerings by proxy.
units.literal: Responsible offices had the Minister of Education act in place for the three offerings.

units.zh: 其親行朝日，金初用本國禮，天會四年正月，始朝日於乾元殿，而後受賀。
units.en: When the emperor greeted the sun in person, early Jin used native rites; in the first month of Tianhui 4 they first did so at Qianyuan Hall, then received congratulations.
units.literal: When the emperor personally performed the sun-greeting, early Jin used their native rites; in the first month of the fourth year of Tianhui they first greeted the sun at the Qianyuan Hall, then received congratulations.

units.zh: 天眷二年，定朔望朝日儀。
units.en: In Tianjuan 2 the new- and full-moon sun-greeting protocol was established.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianjuan the protocol for greeting the sun at new and full moon was fixed.

units.zh: 皇帝服靴袍，百官常服。
units.en: The emperor wore boots and robe; officials wore regular dress.
units.literal: The emperor wore boots and robe; the hundred officials wore regular dress.

units.zh: 有司設爐案、禦褥位於所禦殿前陛上，設百官褥位於殿門外，皆向日。
units.en: Officers set incense tables and the emperor's cushion on the hall steps and officials' cushions outside the gate—all facing the sun.
units.literal: Responsible offices set incense tables and the imperial cushion station on the steps before the hall used, and cushion stations for the hundred officials outside the hall gate—all facing the sun.

units.zh: 宣徽使奏導皇帝至位，南向，再拜，上香，又再拜。
units.en: The Palace Attendant led the emperor to his place; facing south, he bowed twice, offered incense, and bowed twice again.
units.literal: The Palace Attendant reported and led the emperor to his station; south-facing, he bowed twice, offered incense, and bowed twice again.

units.zh: 閣門皆相應贊，殿門外臣僚陪拜如常儀。
units.en: Gate officers called in response; officials outside the hall accompanied the bows as usual.
units.literal: Gate officers all responded with announcements; officials outside the hall gate accompanied the bowing as in regular protocol.

units.zh: 大定二年，以無典故罷。
units.en: In Dading 2 it was discontinued for lack of precedent.
units.literal: In the second year of Dading it was discontinued for lack of precedent.

units.zh: 十五年，言事者謂今正旦並萬春節，宜令有司定拜日之禮。
units.en: In year 15 memorialists urged that with New Year's and the Myriad Spring Festival together, officers should fix the sun-bowing protocol.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year, memorialists said that with New Year's Day and the Myriad Spring Festival together, responsible offices should fix the protocol for bowing to the sun.

units.zh: 有司援據漢、唐春分朝日，升煙奠玉如圜丘之儀。
units.en: Officers cited Han and Tang spring-equinox sun rites—raising smoke and presenting jade as at the round mound.
units.literal: Responsible offices cited Han and Tang spring-equinox sun-greeting, raising smoke and presenting jade as at the round mound.

units.zh: 又按唐《開元禮》，南向設大明神位，天子北向，皆無南向拜日之制。
units.en: They also noted the Tang Kaiyuan Rites: the Bright God faced south, the Son of Heaven north—nowhere did one bow south to the sun.
units.literal: They also checked the Tang Kaiyuan Rites: the Bright God seat faced south, the Son of Heaven faced north—nowhere was there a protocol of south-facing bow to the sun.

units.zh: 今已奉敕以月朔拜日，宜遵古制，殿前東向拜。
units.en: An edict had ordered sun-bowing at each month's start; they should follow ancient usage and bow east before the hall.
units.literal: Now an edict had ordered bowing to the sun at the month's beginning; they should follow ancient protocol and bow east before the hall.

units.zh: 詔姑從南向。
units.en: The edict for the time being kept the south-facing bow.
units.literal: The edict for the time being followed south-facing.

units.zh: 其日，先引臣僚于殿門外立，陪位立殿前班露臺左右，皇帝于露臺香案拜如上儀。
units.en: That day officials stood outside the gate; companions flanked the open terrace before the hall; the emperor bowed at the terrace incense table as above.
units.literal: On that day officials were first led to stand outside the hall gate; those accompanying stood left and right on the open terrace before the hall; the emperor bowed at the incense table on the terrace by the protocol above.

units.zh: 十八年，上拜日于仁政殿，始行東向之禮。
units.en: In year 18 the emperor bowed to the sun at Renzheng Hall and first used the east-facing rite.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year the emperor bowed to the sun at the Renzheng Hall and first performed the east-facing rite.

units.zh: 皇帝出殿，東向設位，宣徽贊：「拜。」
units.en: The emperor left the hall to an east-facing station; the Palace Attendant called: "Bow."
units.literal: The emperor left the hall; his station was set east-facing; the Palace Attendant announced: "Bow."

units.zh: 皇帝再拜，上香，訖，又再拜。
units.en: The emperor bowed twice, offered incense, then bowed twice again.
units.literal: The emperor bowed twice, offered incense; when finished he bowed twice again.

units.zh: 臣僚並陪拜，依班次起居，如常儀。
units.en: Officials accompanied the bows and rose and sat by rank, as usual.
units.literal: Officials all accompanied the bowing and rose and sat according to rank, as in regular protocol.

units.zh: 明昌六年，章宗未有子，尚書省臣奏行高禖之祀，乃築壇于景風門外東南端，當闕之卯辰地，與圜丘東西相望，壇如北郊之制。
units.en: In Mingchang 6, Zhangzong had no heir; the Secretariat urged the Gaomei sacrifice; an altar was built southeast outside Jingfeng Gate, opposite the palace at mao-chen, facing the round mound—the northern suburban model.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Mingchang, Zhangzong had no son; Secretariat officials memorialized to perform the Gaomei sacrifice; they built an altar at the southeast outside the Jingfeng Gate, at the mao-chen position opposite the palace gate, facing the round mound east and west—the altar followed northern suburban protocol.

units.zh: 歲以春分日祀青帝、伏羲氏、女媧氏，凡三位，壇上南向，西上。
units.en: Each spring equinox they sacrificed to the Green Emperor, Fuxi, and Nüwa—three south-facing seats on the altar, ranked from the west.
units.literal: Each year on the spring equinox they sacrificed to the Green Emperor, Fuxi, and Nüwa—three seats on the altar, south-facing, ranked from the west upward.

units.zh: 姜嫄、簡狄位於壇之第二層，東向，北上。
units.en: Jiang Yuan and Jiandi stood on the second tier, facing east and ranked from the north.
units.literal: Jiang Yuan and Jiandi were on the altar's second tier, east-facing, ranked from the north upward.

units.zh: 前一日未三刻，布神位，省牲器，陳禦弓矢弓䪅於上下神位之右。
units.en: The day before, three quarters before wei, they set the seats, inspected victims and vessels, and placed imperial bows, arrows, and quivers to the right of each seat.
units.literal: On the previous day, three quarters before wei, they set out spirit seats, inspected victims and vessels, and displayed imperial bows, arrows, and quivers to the right of the upper and lower spirit seats.

units.zh: 其齋戒、奠玉幣、進熟，皆如大祀儀。
units.en: Purification, jade and silks, and cooked offerings all followed the great-sacrifice protocol.
units.literal: Purification, presentation of jade and silks, and presenting cooked offerings—all followed the great-sacrifice protocol.

units.zh: 青帝幣玉皆用青，餘皆無玉。
units.en: The Green Emperor's silks and jade were green; the others had no jade.
units.literal: For the Green Emperor, silks and jade were all green; the rest had no jade.

units.zh: 每位牲用羊一、豕一。
units.en: Each seat received one sheep and one pig.
units.literal: Each seat used one sheep and one pig.

units.zh: 有司攝三獻司徒行事。
units.en: Officers had the Minister of Education perform the three offerings by proxy.
units.literal: Responsible offices had the Minister of Education act in place for the three offerings.

units.zh: 禮畢，進胙，倍於他祀之肉。
units.en: When the rite was done they presented sacrificial flesh—twice the amount of other sacrifices.
units.literal: When the rite was finished they presented sacrificial flesh—twice the meat of other sacrifices.

units.zh: 進胙官佩弓矢䪅以進，上命後妃嬪禦皆執弓矢東向而射，乃命以次飲福享胙。
units.en: The flesh-bearer advanced wearing bow, arrows, and quiver; the emperor ordered consorts and palace women to take bows, face east, and shoot; then they drank the blessing and shared the sacrificial flesh in turn.
units.literal: The officer presenting the flesh wore bow, arrows, and quiver as he advanced; the emperor ordered consorts, concubines, and palace women all to take bows and arrows, face east, and shoot; then he ordered them in turn to drink the blessing and enjoy the sacrificial flesh.
